verification.notes: Draft, not reviewed by a NECTA or Ministry officer. Firmest: the seven CSEE core subjects, optional groups and ten-subject ceiling (NECTA CSEE page, fetched); exam names (NECTA home page, fetched); PSLE paper grades and six subjects (NECTA PDFs, search index only). Open: (1) CSEE marks A 75-100, B 65-74, C 45-64, D 30-44, F 0-29, points 1 to 5 and divisions 7-17, 18-21, 22-25, 26-33, 34-35 come from secondary sources that agree; no fetched NECTA document states them, and NECTA revised its grading for the 2023 curriculum (tables unreadable), so they may be out of date. (2) The division adds the seven core subjects only: NECTA takes the best seven by lowest points and best_n takes the highest values; a candidate with other best seven needs school-entered points. (3) Other division conditions (minimum passes, conduct, Civics) differ by source and are not modelled. (4) ACSEE, Form V and VI: not confirmed, not modelled. (5) NECTA's continuous-assessment weights were not found: each scheme is one term paper (50 marks Standard I-VII, 100 Form I-IV). (6) The six PSLE subjects apply to every standard; Standard VI's assessment is not modelled. (7) Technical and home-economics subjects are not all listed. (8) Term dates are pre-fills. (9) Promotion thresholds (21 of 50, 30 of 100) are the pass grade lower bounds, a suggestion, not a national rule. (10) Swahili labels are a draft no native speaker reviewed.
